card.name: Words within disaster news stories
card.fires_on: Small linking words, punctuation or digits inside narrative reports of disasters, such as nuclear accidents, shipwrecks or explosions. It fires on the word right after the event or place, like 'after', 'in', 'of', 'over'.

modes.label: Linking words after a disaster
modes.description: Prepositions that follow a disaster or event name and lead into the place, time or victim.
